# Fluxvex

Fluxvex is an automated client-reporting platform for digital marketing agencies. It turns Google Ads, Meta Ads, and GA4 data into consistent, white-label client reports without rebuilding spreadsheets and slides every reporting cycle.

- Primary audience: small and growing digital marketing agencies reporting to multiple clients.
- Initial integration focus: Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Google Analytics 4.
- Status: pre-launch. The site currently collects waitlist signups and contact inquiries.
- Programs displayed on the site: Product Hunt, StartupBase, Meta Tech Partner, AWS Startups, Microsoft Azure Startups, and Sarvam.

## Pages

- / — Main landing page: product story, workflow, features, sample report, ROI calculator, pricing preview, FAQ.
- /pricing — Two upcoming plans (Starter, Growth); pricing is not yet disclosed—shown as a locked preview with USD and INR views, final pricing announced before launch.
- /security — Security and privacy approach: what data Fluxvex plans to access and the current control status.
- /contact — Short inquiry form for product and walkthrough questions.
- /privacy-policy — Privacy Policy (draft pending final legal review; highlighted fields completed before final publication).
- /terms — Terms of Service (draft pending final legal review).
